<summary>
Progress: Stage 1 fully read; stage 2 released (step 6 reads started, output not yet seen). Stage 3 not released.

Stage 1 facts:
- Symptom: stage-1/logs/ingress-a.log:71 08:17:49Z 503 upstream timeout; stage-1/logs/quotes-api.log:139 first "rates-svc timed out after 600ms" (~95 lines).
- deploy/deploys.log:4 08:16:21Z build 7.20.4-0a00 (prev 7.19.0).
- release-notes-7.20.4-0a00.md:8 timeout_ms 2500->600; :16 db.pool.max_size 48->12. config yaml:7 (2500), :11 (48) superseded.
- quotes-api.log:150,177,219,357,410,613,671 "db pool wait ... (in_use 12/12)".
- Noise: GC, TLS cert not expired, disk warnings, DNS retries ok.

Stage 2 (09:30-10:30): on-call mitigation in stage-2/deploy/changes.log stopped rates-svc timeouts; ingress still 503 with a different error (likely DB pool exhaustion, max_size=12).

Leading hypothesis now: DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED / RAISE_DB_POOL_LIMIT; original change release-notes:16.

Next: read stage-2 changes.log (APPLIED vs PROPOSED), oncall notes, quotes-api.log error patterns, ingress first 503, metrics csv; then advance to stage 3, check later APPLIED pool changes. Notes in /task/workspace/notes.txt.
</summary>
